name: Smallest set whose pairwise sums cover 0..212
description: construct() -> distinct integers in 0..212 such that every integer 0..212 equals a + b for some a <= b in the set (a = b allowed). Minimize the size; the optimum is 25. For n = 212 the minimum is 25, so the task recovers an extremal basis.

sources.locator: Michael F. Challis and John P. Robinson, Some Extremal Postage Stamp Bases (2010). Journal of Integer Sequences article and OEIS A066063/A001212 inspected: the two-stamp postage problem has optimal range 212 with 24 denominations and 196 with 23, and a basis of {0..n} is 0 together with a set of denominations, so the minimum size for n = 212 is 25. Erdős Problem #791 page inspected (Rohrbach's problem; (2.181+o(1))n <= g(n)^2 <= (3.458+o(1))n by Yu and Kohonen). For n = 212 the minimum is 25, so the task recovers an extremal basis.
Erdős Problem #791 (open); statement, history and current bounds reviewed 2026-09-24.
JSP-000650; pinned discovery source, independently paraphrased. Primary mathematical attribution follows the papers above.
